npiNumber.title: NPI number (for a single direct lookup)
npiNumber.description: 10-digit NPI number to look up directly. Leave blank to search by name/location instead.

lastName.title: Last name or organization name (for a single search)
lastName.description: Individual provider's last name, or an organization's name. Leave the Queries (multiple) field below empty to use this single-search shortcut instead.

firstName.title: First name (optional, for a single search)
firstName.description: Only used together with Last name above, for individual providers.

state.title: State (optional, for a single search)
state.description: Two-letter state code to narrow results, e.g. "NY".

taxonomyDescription.title: Specialty/taxonomy (optional, for a single search)
taxonomyDescription.description: Provider specialty to filter by, e.g. "Dentist" or "Family Medicine".

queries.title: Queries (multiple)
queries.description: For running several lookups in one go instead of one at a time. One entry per query: { "npiNumber" } or { "lastName", "firstName", "state", "taxonomyDescription" }. Ignored if Last name/NPI number above is filled in.

maxResults.title: Max results per query
maxResults.description: Maximum number of matches to return per query (NPPES API max is 200).
